dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I wonder what secrets could be hidden within this Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I mean, I know we're supposed to be having a break, but I couldn't call myself a professional journalist if I let the mysteries here go unexplored!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Good thing I've got my notebook with me. Hey, maybe I'll be able to land an interview with the person in charge!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ooh, are you going further in? Take me with you! Please?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I'm sure there'll be plenty of challenges for us to face...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But if there's a chance of discovering the truth behind this place, it'll definitely be worth the risk.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: According to my interviews, this Domain might be related to a famous author of fairy tales.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Are the stories supposed to be an analogy for something? What clues could lay hidden in those pages?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh, I'd love to meet one of the writer's descendants — I have a looong list of questions for them here in my notebook!
